## Summary and scope

Describe the exact device/ROM/app version and the smallest intended change.

## Safety and validation

- [ ] Read-only audit is separate from explicit mutation
- [ ] Exact target/version/hash checks fail closed
- [ ] Backup and rollback were exercised
- [ ] Relevant parser, JSON, shell, and build checks pass
- [ ] Unrelated wallet, NFC, passkey, camera, weather, gallery, and push behavior was considered
- [ ] No secrets, private data, proprietary binaries, raw logs, or device identifiers are included
